Caitlyn.laning: Do not play recklessly and give up a kill early; it is fine to farm under your turret. Once you can push the lane with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb, crash the wave into the enemy turret and pressure it with Ziggs P Short Fuse’s empowered basic attack. Before pushing, make sure Ziggs W Satchel Charge is available and check your vision.
Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn is strongest in lane, so do not overreach early. Ziggs gets stronger late as his ability power builds, but he is fragile, so stay farther back.
Caitlyn.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Caitlyn deals mostly physical damage, and Ziggs has low armor, so build armor first.
Caitlyn.combo: Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield under Caitlyn or along her retreat path, then throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb as soon as she is slowed.
Caitlyn.escape: Avoid engaging through passages where Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap is placed. If you may need Ziggs W Satchel Charge to escape, do not use it to engage; place it between you and Caitlyn so it knocks you backward.
Caitlyn.fight: Poke with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from outside Caitlyn’s basic attack range.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Start from behind your team, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield on Caitlyn’s approach, and attack with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. Aim for the center of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb where enemies are grouped. Save Ziggs W Satchel Charge to protect yourself, and step into the path of the bullet to take it for an ally targeted by Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole.
Caitlyn.watch: Stepping on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap roots you and increases the range of Caitlyn P Headshot, dealing heavy damage. Expect traps in bushes and narrow passages and change your route. Stand behind minions so they take Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker first.

Ezreal.build: Get a mana item first so you can pressure the lane with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. Ezreal deals different types of damage with Q Mystic Shot and W Essence Flux and E Arcane Shift, so building just one type of resistance is not enough.
Ezreal.watch: Use minions as cover to dodge Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, and avoid repeated hits so Ezreal E Arcane Shift does not come back quickly. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, briefly get out of range before his next attack or spell hits. When your health is low, keep in mind Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage and do not retreat in a straight line alongside your allies.
Ezreal.combo: When Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield under him or on his escape route, then hit him with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb as soon as he is slowed. If you place Ziggs W Satchel Charge behind Ezreal, throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb first, then detonate the charge to knock him into its landing spot.
Ezreal.escape: Ezreal has no crowd control, so the window to engage is immediately after Ezreal E Arcane Shift has been used. Use Ziggs W Satchel Charge to close the gap then, while continuing to get hit by Ezreal Q Mystic Shot so that E Arcane Shift does not become available again quickly.
Ezreal.fight: Poke from Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb’s range, and close the gap right after Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down. Repeatedly getting hit by Ezreal Q Mystic Shot shortens that window, so keep minions between you and Ezreal as you move. Ziggs W Satchel Charge is also your only way out, so use it from a position where you can fight safely.
Ezreal.laning: Block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot with minions, and throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb where Ezreal will last-hit or when he stops to cast a spell. Block his retreat path with Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield and push the wave into the turret to apply pressure. Before pushing, check your vision and make sure Ziggs W Satchel Charge is ready.
Ezreal.phase: Ziggs is strongest late once his ability power builds, but he is fragile, so fight from farther back.
Ezreal.teamfight: Start behind your team, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield on Ezreal’s approach, and keep throwing Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. When Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down, look for an angle to close the gap with your team. Aim Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb when enemies group up or are in a narrow area. Use Ziggs W Satchel Charge with the fact that you have only one chance to protect yourself in mind.

Aphelios.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil does not hit several of you, and start fights from behind your team. Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield on the approach and poke with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. Aim for the center of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb when enemies group up or are trapped in a narrow area. Look for a chance to catch Aphelios with your team when he is not holding Severum.
Aphelios.build: Aphelios deals mostly physical damage, and Ziggs has low armor, so build Cloth Armor first to survive, then buy Plated Steelcaps. If Aphelios’s healing makes fights drag on, fit Morellonomicon into your build after your first core item to reduce his healing.
Aphelios.combo: Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield under Aphelios or along his retreat path, then throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb as soon as he is slowed. If you can use Ziggs W Satchel Charge to attack, place it behind Aphelios, throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb, then knock Aphelios into its landing spot.
Aphelios.escape: After the threat of Aphelios’s Gravitum slow and Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites root has passed, pick a weapon phase with low burst damage and use Ziggs W Satchel Charge to close the gap. When Aphelios is not holding Severum, he has almost no way to escape besides Flash, but Ziggs W Satchel Charge is your only mobility tool, so do not use it to engage when you may need it to escape.
Aphelios.fight: Check the next weapon shown on Aphelios E Weapon Queue System, and trade during a weapon phase with low burst damage. Poke with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from outside basic attack range, then limit Aphelios’s movement by placing Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield along his retreat path.
Aphelios.laning: Before pushing the lane, make sure Ziggs W Satchel Charge is ready and you have vision. Back away when a Calibrum mark is applied so you do not keep losing health to it.
Aphelios.phase: Ziggs is strongest late, once he has built up ability power, but he is fragile, so fight from farther back.
Aphelios.watch: If Aphelios’s Gravitum basic attack slows you, get out of range and create distance from your allies before Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites roots you. When Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil is available, spread out in advance because hitting champions triggers one extra attack from his main weapon on each target hit. If a Calibrum mark is applied to you, back away immediately to avoid the follow-up attack.

Jhin.combo: Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield under Jhin or along his retreat path to slow him, then throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. If you place Ziggs W Satchel Charge on Jhin’s escape route, throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb first, then detonate the charge to knock him into its landing spot. Do not use Ziggs W Satchel Charge in your poke combo if you need it to escape.
Jhin.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Jhin deals mostly physical damage, and Ziggs has low armor, so build armor first. Armor does not block the magic damage from Jhin E Captive Audience.
Jhin.escape: If you dodge Jhin W Deadly Flourish and Jhin is reloading, that is your chance to engage. Jhin has no spell to create distance, so you can use Ziggs W Satchel Charge to close the gap. Do not go in while Jhin has his final shot ready or if you need to save Ziggs W Satchel Charge to escape.
Jhin.fight: Avoid trading while Jhin has his final shot ready. Fight while he is reloading or after he has fired one or two shots. Poke with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from outside his basic attack range, and if Jhin steps forward, block his retreat path with Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield. Use Ziggs W Satchel Charge to close the gap after dodging Jhin W Deadly Flourish, if you can.
Jhin.laning: Throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb where Jhin will walk to last-hit from behind his minions. Stay away from low-health minions to reduce damage from Jhin Q Dancing Grenade bouncing to you. Push with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb to pressure the turret, but before pushing, make sure Ziggs W Satchel Charge is ready and you have vision.
Jhin.phase: Invest more in Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb and push to pressure the turret once you have a mana item. Ziggs is strongest late as his ability power builds, but he is fragile, so fight from farther back.
Jhin.teamfight: Start behind your frontline, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield on Jhin’s approach, and poke with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. Aim for the center of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb where enemies are grouped. Save Ziggs W Satchel Charge to protect yourself, and dodge the shots from Jhin R Curtain Call when your health is low.
Jhin.watch: When Jhin P Whisper’s final shot is ready, back away to avoid heavy damage. Immediately after being hit by Jhin’s basic attack or stepping on Jhin E Captive Audience, move out of a straight line to dodge the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Jhin Q Dancing Grenade gets stronger when it bounces from a target it kills, so do not stand near low-health minions. When your health is low, dodge Jhin R Curtain Call, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, the stacks on Yasuo Q Steel Tempest reset, creating an opportunity to engage. If Yasuo R Last Breath isn’t ready yet, look to engage with crowd control and close the distance with Ziggs W Satchel Charge. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is a short-cooldown mobility ability, so don’t engage just because he used it once.
Yasuo.build: Weather the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first because Yasuo’s main damage is physical and Ziggs has low armor. If you’re struggling to handle Yasuo’s engage, get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier.
Yasuo.combo: Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield along Yasuo’s retreat route, then throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb when he is slowed. If Yasuo’s tornado is down and you have a chance to close the distance, you can use Ziggs W Satchel Charge to knock him toward Q’s landing point.
Yasuo.fight: First break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb, then start trading. Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield along Yasuo’s approach to slow him, then hit him with Q. While Yasuo W Wind Wall is active, go around the wall or save your key abilities.
Yasuo.laning: Take advantage of the wave being thinly pushed toward Ziggs so Yasuo E Sweeping Blade has fewer minions to use as stepping stones. Before pushing the lane to pressure the turret, first check your vision and whether Ziggs W Satchel Charge is ready. In front of the turret, use abilities to advance your passive and land an empowered attack; save W if you can destroy the weakened turret.
Yasuo.phase: Late game, when Ziggs has built up ability power, is his strongest point, but stay farther back because he is fragile.
Yasuo.teamfight: Ziggs starts behind his allies and places Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield in advance along Yasuo’s approach. Once the fight starts, keep throwing Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb and use Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb when the enemy is grouped up or in terrain that makes escape difficult. Save Ziggs W Satchel Charge so you can get away if Yasuo reaches you.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions as stepping stones to reach Ziggs, so be careful about your distance around large minion waves. After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits twice in a row, he prepares a tornado knock-up; move off the line and dodge to the side. When Yasuo W Wind Wall is up, go around the wall or save Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb until it disappears.

Jinx.fight: Take short trades with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from outside Jinx’s basic attack range. If Jinx has used Jinx E Flame Chompers! or it missed, and Jinx W Zap! also missed, that is a chance to close the gap with Ziggs W Satchel Charge. Do not use it for poke if you may need it to escape.
Jinx.build: Jinx deals mostly physical damage, and Ziggs has low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Armor does not block the magic damage from Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Jinx.combo: Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield under Jinx or along her retreat path, then throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb when she is slowed. After Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down, place Ziggs W Satchel Charge behind Jinx, throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb, then detonate the charge to knock her into the bomb’s landing spot.
Jinx.escape: Jinx has no spell to create distance, so engage when Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down or has missed. If Jinx W Zap! also misses, you can use Ziggs W Satchel Charge to close the gap. Do not start a fight right after Jinx gets a takedown or a turret is destroyed, since her movement speed increases then.
Jinx.laning: When Jinx uses rockets to hit minions, poke with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from a spot that does not overlap with a minion. When Jinx stops to last-hit or uses a spell, throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb where she will walk rather than where she is standing. Before pushing the lane to pressure the turret, make sure you have vision and Ziggs W Satchel Charge is ready.
Jinx.phase: Early on, Ziggs’s Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb poke has a slow rotation, so endure and avoid long basic attack trades with Jinx. Ziggs is strongest late, but he is fragile, so stay farther back and avoid fights right after Jinx gets a takedown.
Jinx.teamfight: Start behind your team, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield on Jinx’s approach, and poke with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. Aim for the center of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb when enemies are grouped or trapped in a narrow area. Ziggs W Satchel Charge is a way to protect yourself, so do not step forward to look for an angle with it.
Jinx.watch: When Jinx uses Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets to hit minions, do not stand right next to a minion. Jinx E Flame Chompers! can root you and Jinx W Zap! can slow you, making it hard to keep your distance, so position to avoid being hit. If health has been reduced, do not stay within range of Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!.

Draven.build: Draven deals mostly physical damage, and Ziggs has low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Keep your total health in mind so you can stay above the execute threshold of Draven R Whirling Death.
Draven.combo: Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield where an axe will land or along Draven’s retreat path, then throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb as soon as he is slowed. If you place Ziggs W Satchel Charge behind Draven, throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb first, then detonate the charge to knock him into its landing spot. Prioritize knocking him away from where he would catch an axe with Ziggs W Satchel Charge as well.
Draven.escape: Draven has no spell to create distance, so look to engage when Draven E Stand Aside is down and he has one or fewer axes. You can use Ziggs W Satchel Charge to close the gap, but save it if you may need it to escape.
Draven.fight: Avoid trading while Draven holds two Draven Q Spinning Axes. Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield where he will catch an axe or use Ziggs W Satchel Charge to knock him away from it and make him miss the catch. If he has one or fewer axes and Draven E Stand Aside is down, look for a chance to fight by using Ziggs W Satchel Charge to close the gap.
Draven.laning: Poke with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from outside Draven’s basic attack range, and target the spots where his axes will land. If trading is difficult early, farm safely and do not give Draven a kill. Before pushing the lane to pressure the turret, make sure Ziggs W Satchel Charge is ready and you have vision.
Draven.phase: Early on, Draven is strong in trades while holding two axes, so farm safely as Ziggs. Ziggs is strongest late once his ability power builds, but he is fragile, so stay farther back. Look with your team for chances to catch Draven alone, since he relies on early gold.
Draven.teamfight: Start behind your team and place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield on Draven’s approach and where his axes will land. Once the fight starts, poke with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb and aim Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb at grouped enemies. Keep Ziggs W Satchel Charge’s role in protecting yourself in mind, and do not step forward to find an angle.
Draven.watch: Draven’s basic attacks hit hard early while he holds two Draven Q Spinning Axes, so avoid trading. Watch for the forced movement and slow from Draven E Stand Aside, and do not stand in the return path after dodging Draven R Whirling Death once. If your health is low, watch out for the execute from Draven R Whirling Death.

Kaisa.build: Kai'Sa deals mostly physical damage, and Ziggs has low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Kaisa.combo: Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield under Kai'Sa or along her retreat path, then hit her with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb when she is slowed. If you can safely close the gap, place Ziggs W Satchel Charge behind Kai'Sa, throw Q, then detonate the charge to knock her into where Q will land.
Kaisa.escape: You can use Ziggs W Satchel Charge to close the gap here, but using W also leaves you without an escape, so check for nearby threats that could engage.
Kaisa.fight: Poke from Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb’s range, and if Kai'Sa steps forward, block her retreat path with Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield. However, Ziggs W Satchel Charge is your only mobility tool, so do not use it to engage when you may need it to escape.
Kaisa.laning: Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb has a long cooldown and you are short on mana at this point, so aim it at the moment Kai'Sa tries to last-hit. Then push the wave into the turret and pressure it with Ziggs P Short Fuse’s empowered basic attack, but before pushing, check your vision and make sure Ziggs W Satchel Charge is ready.
Kaisa.phase: Ziggs gets stronger late as his ability power builds, but he is fragile, so fight from farther back.
Kaisa.teamfight: Before the fight, place Control Ward in side bushes and on approach routes, and put Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield on Kai'Sa’s path in. Attack with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from behind your team, then aim Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb when enemies group up. If Kai'Sa dives in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, knock her back with Ziggs W Satchel Charge and attack her with your team so she cannot escape.
Kaisa.watch: If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, she can dive in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, so retreat toward your allies until the mark disappears. When Kai'Sa looks ready to use Q Icathian Rain, stand near allied minions so the missiles spread out. If Kai'Sa P Second Skin stacks have built up, get out of range and wait for them to fall off.

Kalista.build: Early on, hold out with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first because Kalista's main damage is physical. Kalista W Sentinel deals magic damage based on max health, so armor alone cannot stop it.
Kalista.combo: Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield beneath Kalista or in her retreat path, then throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb when she is slowed. If you can afford to use Ziggs W Satchel Charge to poke, place it behind Kalista, throw Q, then detonate the charge to knock her into Q's landing spot.
Kalista.escape: Once the engage in which Kalista throws her support with Kalista R Fate's Call has passed, you can take advantage of that opening to fight. You can use Ziggs W Satchel Charge to close the gap, but save it if you may need to escape. If Kalista gets on top of you, knock her away with W and place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield along the retreat path.
Kalista.fight: Trade damage with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from outside Kalista's basic attack range. Throw Q just as Kalista starts a basic attack, and if she gets close, use Ziggs W Satchel Charge to knock her away and get out of attack range. If she has stacked several spears in you, retreat rather than keep fighting.
Kalista.laning: When pushing the wave with Q and pressuring the turret, first check that you have vision and Ziggs W Satchel Charge is ready. If Kalista steps forward, block her retreat with Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield.
Kalista.phase: Ziggs is at his strongest in the late game once he has built ability power, but he is fragile, so fight from farther back.
Kalista.teamfight: Start behind your allies and place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield in the path Kalista and her support will take to engage. If it looks like Kalista R Fate's Call will send her support flying in, spread out, then keep throwing Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb once the fight starts. Aim for the center of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb when the enemy team is grouped or in terrain that makes it hard to escape.
Kalista.watch: Kalista stacks spears with basic attacks, then cashes them in for damage with Kalista E Rend, so break off the fight and retreat if she has stacked several spears in you. Kalista has to begin a basic attack to hop, so throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb just as she starts an attack rather than after you see the hop. If her bound support sticks close to her, avoid the expected landing spot in case of Kalista R Fate's Call.

KogMaw.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first to prepare for Kog'Maw's main ability damage, while also accounting for the physical damage from his basic attacks.
KogMaw.combo: Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield in Kog'Maw's retreat path or beneath him, then throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb when he is slowed. When Kog'Maw stops to cast an ability, throw Q where he will walk. You can also use Ziggs W Satchel Charge to knock Kog'Maw into Q's landing spot.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no mobility, so the window to close the gap is after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze is down. You can approach with Ziggs W Satchel Charge, but if you need to get away, use W between yourself and Kog'Maw to disengage.
KogMaw.fight: Keep your distance until Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends, then poke with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. After Kog'Maw E Void Ooze is down, block his retreat with Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield and fight. You can use Ziggs W Satchel Charge if you have a clear chance to close the gap and finish him, but save it if you need it to escape.
KogMaw.laning: Afterward, push the wave with Q to disrupt Kog'Maw's farming, then use the wave under his turret to pressure it with Ziggs P Short Fuse empowered attacks. Before pushing the lane, check that Ziggs W Satchel Charge is ready and that you have vision.
KogMaw.phase: In the early and mid game, pressure the wave and turret to hinder Kog'Maw's growth as he gets stronger over time. Ziggs also gets strong in the late game as he builds ability power, but he is fragile, so fight from farther back.
KogMaw.teamfight: Start behind your allies, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield in Kog'Maw's path in, and poke with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. Kog'Maw has no ability to create distance on his own, so focus him if your allies lock him down. Aim Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb at the center of a clustered enemy group or terrain that makes escape difficult, and use Ziggs W Satchel Charge carefully so you can protect yourself.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, Kog'Maw gains increased attack range and damage based on maximum health, so keep your distance until it expires. Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle lowers your armor and magic resistance, so block it with minions or dodge to the side; if it hits you, avoid trading for a short time. When low on health, watch out for Kog'Maw R Living Artillery, move out of vision, and recover. After killing Kog'Maw, move away from his body to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.

MissFortune.build: Miss Fortune's main damage is physical and Ziggs has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Early on, hold out with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
MissFortune.combo: Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield beneath Miss Fortune or in her retreat path to slow her, then hit her with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. If you placed Ziggs W Satchel Charge behind Miss Fortune, throw Q and detonate the charge immediately afterward to knock her into Q's landing spot.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility, so look for a chance to close the gap with Ziggs W Satchel Charge after Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is down. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, you can interrupt her channel with the forced movement from Ziggs W Satchel Charge. If things get dangerous after you engage, you won't be able to use W to disengage, so check your position before going in.
MissFortune.fight: Ziggs trades damage with Miss Fortune using Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from outside her basic attack range. Immediately after Miss Fortune last-hits a minion, create distance to avoid her empowered basic attack poke. Once Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is down, you can avoid its slow; if you have an angle to close the gap, you can engage with Ziggs W Satchel Charge.
MissFortune.laning: Stand to the side rather than directly behind a minion to dodge the bounce from Miss Fortune Q Double Up. When Miss Fortune stops to last-hit or cast an ability, throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb where she will walk. Before pushing the lane to pressure the turret, first check that Ziggs W Satchel Charge is ready and that you have vision.
MissFortune.phase: After putting more skill points into Q and getting a mana item, push the lane to pressure the turret.
MissFortune.teamfight: Start behind your allies, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield in the enemy's path in, and attack with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. Don't start a fight where Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is active; move out of the area. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, interrupt it with Ziggs W Satchel Charge, and aim for the center of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb when the enemy team is grouped.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces from its first target to the one behind it, so don't stand in a line with minions. It's dangerous if Miss Fortune R Bullet Time overlaps the slow from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, so move out of the area. When Bullet Time starts, interrupt it with Ziggs W Satchel Charge or move to the side of the cone fixed when she casts it.

Nilah.build: Nilah's main damage is physical, so hold out with Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps. Nilah Q Formless Blade has armor penetration, so build health too instead of relying on armor alone; if her healing is a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon after your first core item.
Nilah.combo: Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield in Nilah's path when she comes up to last-hit or in her retreat path, then throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb where she is slowed. If the risk of Nilah engaging is low and you don't need Ziggs W Satchel Charge to escape, place W behind Nilah and knock her into Q's landing spot.
Nilah.escape: Even when Nilah E Slipstream is down, its cooldown is short, so don't engage based on that alone. After Nilah engages with E and uses Nilah R Apotheosis, manage the distance with Ziggs W Satchel Charge and respond with Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield and Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb.
Nilah.fight: Poke with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb before Nilah can reach you, and place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield in her approach path to slow her. When Nilah activates Nilah W Jubilant Veil, don't try to land empowered basic attacks; respond with abilities and save Ziggs W Satchel Charge so you can disengage.
Nilah.laning: Afterward, when pushing the wave with Q to pressure the turret, first check that you have vision and Ziggs W Satchel Charge is ready.
Nilah.phase: Ziggs's poke cycle is slow early, but it's important to pressure Nilah from outside her range so she can't get on top of you. Ziggs is at his strongest in the late game once he has built ability power, but he is still fragile, so fight from farther back.
Nilah.teamfight: Start behind your allies, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield in the path Nilah E Slipstream will take, and spread out so you aren't caught together in Nilah R Apotheosis. Keep using Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb once the fight starts, and aim for the center of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb when the enemy team is grouped. Save Ziggs W Satchel Charge so you can create distance if Nilah gets on top of you.
Nilah.watch: When Nilah closes the gap with Nilah E Slipstream, watch out for the increased range and area damage from Nilah Q Formless Blade. Spread out from your allies while Nilah has Nilah R Apotheosis ready so several of you aren't pulled in together.

Samira.build: Samira's main damage is physical and Ziggs has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Early on, hold out with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Samira.combo: When Samira walks up, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield beneath her or in her retreat path, then throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb when she is slowed. If Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, use Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb after the spin ends. When using Ziggs W Satchel Charge to attack, place it behind Samira, throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb, then knock her into its landing spot.
Samira.escape: You can close the gap with Ziggs W Satchel Charge if you have also dodged the enemy support's engage ability or it has already been used up. If you need to retreat again, place Ziggs W Satchel Charge between Ziggs and Samira to knock Ziggs backward.
Samira.fight: Poke with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from outside Samira's short range, and if she steps forward, limit her path with Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield. Use projectiles and basic attacks after Samira W Blade Whirl ends. If Samira E Wild Rush is down and no one has died, that's a chance to attack her.
Samira.laning: In bot lane, poke Samira with the range of Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb rather than trading basic attack range. Use Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb to push the wave and create time to pressure the turret, but before pushing, check that Ziggs W Satchel Charge is ready and that you have vision. If the enemy support has an engage ability, stand behind your support.
Samira.phase: The late game, when Ziggs has built ability power, is when he is strong, but he is fragile, so fight from farther back.
Samira.teamfight: Start behind your allies, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield in Samira's path in, and poke with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. When Samira R Inferno Trigger starts, interrupt it with the knockback from Ziggs W Satchel Charge. If Samira used Samira E Wild Rush to engage and no one has died, attack her then; when retreating, don't leave a low-health ally behind.
Samira.watch: While Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, it blocks projectiles and basic attacks, so save Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb and basic attacks until the spin ends. If you are hit by the enemy support's crowd control, Samira can immediately close the gap with Samira P Daredevil Impulse, so dodge that engage ability first. When Samira gets close and builds style, she can use Samira R Inferno Trigger, so break off time spent in close range.

Senna.build: Senna's main damage is physical and Ziggs has low armor, so hold out with Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps. If the healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness is a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon after your first core item.
Senna.combo: Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield in Senna's path when she comes up to collect a soul or in her retreat path. When she is slowed, throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb where she will walk. If you can safely knock her in, place Ziggs W Satchel Charge behind Senna, throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb, then knock her into its landing spot.
Senna.escape: After Senna W Last Embrace misses is a chance to close the gap. Senna has no ability to create distance on her own, so in a safe situation, approach with Ziggs W Satchel Charge. If things get dangerous, place Ziggs W Satchel Charge between Ziggs and Senna to knock Ziggs backward.
Senna.fight: Poke with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from outside Senna's range when she steps forward to collect a soul. If Senna W Last Embrace misses and you can safely close the gap, approach Senna with Ziggs W Satchel Charge. Don't use Ziggs W Satchel Charge to engage if you need it to escape.
Senna.laning: Afterward, push the lane with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb, then pressure the turret when you have vision and Ziggs W Satchel Charge is ready. In front of the turret, use abilities to bring forward Ziggs P Short Fuse empowered attacks, and save Ziggs W Satchel Charge to take down the weakened turret.
Senna.phase: After putting skill points into Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb and getting a mana item, push the lane to disrupt Senna's soul collection. Ziggs gets stronger as he builds ability power in the late game, but Senna also gains range and attack damage as she collects souls, so fight from farther back.
Senna.teamfight: Start from the farthest back, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield in the approach path on Senna's side, and poke with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. Aim Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb at a clustered enemy group, and use Ziggs W Satchel Charge carefully to protect yourself.
Senna.watch: There is a delay between Senna W Last Embrace hitting and the root, so if you get marked, immediately move away from your allies. Block Senna W Last Embrace with minions, but move out of the straight line of Senna Q Piercing Darkness as it passes through minions. If Senna hits you once, retreat immediately so you don't give her Mist by letting her hit you a second time.

Seraphine.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Seraphine's main damage is magic and Ziggs has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound is strong, reduce it with Morellonomicon after your first core item.
Seraphine.combo: Your basic poke sequence is to place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield beneath Seraphine or in her retreat path, then hit her with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb when she is slowed. If Seraphine E Beat Drop is down and you can engage, place Ziggs W Satchel Charge behind Seraphine, throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb, then detonate the charge to knock her into its landing spot.
Seraphine.escape: Right after Seraphine E Beat Drop misses is a chance to go in with Ziggs W Satchel Charge. Seraphine has no mobility, so if you close the gap then, it is hard for her to create distance on her own. Conversely, if you are slowed, first move out of the line of Seraphine E Beat Drop, and when you need to escape, place Ziggs W Satchel Charge between yourself and Seraphine to disengage.
Seraphine.fight: Look to trade when Seraphine is alone, away from an allied marksman. Right after Seraphine E Beat Drop misses, you have a chance to close the gap with Ziggs W Satchel Charge. Block a retreat route with Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, then throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb where the slow is applied.
Seraphine.laning: Poke with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from outside the enemy's basic attack range, and block Seraphine's retreat with Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield if she steps forward. After pushing the wave under the enemy turret, pressure it with Ziggs P Short Fuse empowered attacks. Before pushing the lane, check that you have vision and Ziggs W Satchel Charge ready for escape.
Seraphine.phase: Ziggs is strong in the late game once he has built ability power, but he is fragile, so fight from farther back.
Seraphine.teamfight: Stand spread out to the left and right of your allies to avoid Seraphine R Encore extending behind them. Before the fight, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield in Seraphine's path in, then attack from behind your allies with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. Aim for the center of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb when enemies are grouped or trapped in a narrow area.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets, so if you are slowed, first move out of the straight line in front of Seraphine. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits an allied champion, so don't stand in a line with your allies during team fights. When low on health, also watch out for Seraphine Q High Note, which deals damage based on missing health.

Sivir.build: Sivir’s main damage is physical, and Ziggs has low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to hold on early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Sivir.combo: Bait out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield under her or along her retreat path. If you can afford to use Ziggs W Satchel Charge to engage, place it behind Sivir, throw Q, then knock her toward where Q will land.
Sivir.escape: You can use Ziggs W Satchel Charge here to close the distance or knock Sivir toward your allies. Delay your engage if Sivir R On The Hunt is active or you need W to escape.
Sivir.fight: Harass with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from outside Sivir’s basic attack range. Bait out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then block her path with Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield and hit her with Q when she is slowed. Sivir has no ability to create distance on her own, but Ziggs W Satchel Charge is your only mobility tool, so don’t use it to engage when you may need to escape.
Sivir.laning: Sivir clears waves quickly, so before leaving lane, push the wave first or make sure an ally is ready to catch it. Use Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb to push and create time to pressure the turret, but check for vision and make sure Ziggs W Satchel Charge is ready before pushing. Dodging Sivir Q Boomerang Blade can make her spend mana.
Sivir.phase: Ziggs is strongest in the late game once he has built up Ability Power, but he is fragile, so fight from farther back.
Sivir.teamfight: Start behind your allies, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield along the enemy’s approach, and keep using Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb to harass. Aim the center of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb at enemies who are grouped or trapped in a narrow area. If Sivir E Spell Shield is down, look for a chance to catch her, but while Sivir R On The Hunt is active, take only short fights near terrain and vision.
Sivir.watch: Dodge both the outgoing and returning paths of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one ability, so don’t use Ziggs’s key abilities hastily before it is down. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, her whole team moves faster, so avoid long chases and slow retreats.

Tristana.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Tristana’s damage is mostly magic, and Ziggs has low Magic Resist, so build Magic Resist first. If the enemy also has an assassin who dives onto you, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier.
Tristana.combo: Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield under Tristana or along her retreat path, then throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb as soon as she is slowed. After Tristana W Rocket Jump is down, if you place Ziggs W Satchel Charge behind her, throw Q and knock her toward where it will land.
Tristana.escape: Right after Tristana W Rocket Jump is down is your window to engage. If Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are both available, delay the engage and look for a moment when you’re ready to interrupt her jump with Ziggs W Satchel Charge.
Tristana.fight: Trade with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from outside Tristana’s basic attack range, and block her retreat path with Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield when she steps forward. Immediately after you force Tristana to use W Rocket Jump is your chance to close the distance, but Ziggs W Satchel Charge is your only mobility tool, so save it if you need to escape.
Tristana.laning: Then push the wave with Q to make it harder for Tristana to last-hit under her turret, and pressure the turret with your empowered basic attacks. Before pushing, check that Ziggs W Satchel Charge is back up and you have vision.
Tristana.phase: Ziggs gets stronger in the late game with more Ability Power, but a fully built Tristana is difficult to handle, so aim to finish the game by pushing turrets before then.
Tristana.teamfight: Start behind your allies, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield along Tristana’s approach, and keep throwing Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. Aim Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb at the center of a group, and save Ziggs W Satchel Charge to interrupt Tristana W Rocket Jump or escape. If your allies are taken down and your team is losing ground, Tristana W Rocket Jump may reset repeatedly, so retreat immediately.
Tristana.watch: Tristana W Rocket Jump is used to dash in, and its cooldown resets when she gets a takedown, so be ready to interrupt her with Ziggs W Satchel Charge when she jumps in. Tristana R Buster Shot causes a stun and forced movement, so don’t engage first while both W and R are available. Don’t stand close to allied minions to avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge.

TwistedFate.build: Start by holding on with Null-Magic Mantle. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots and build Magic Resist against Twisted Fate’s main damage.
TwistedFate.combo: Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield under Twisted Fate or along his retreat path, then throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb when he is slowed. When using Ziggs W Satchel Charge to close the distance, place it behind him, throw Q, then knock him toward where Q will land.
TwistedFate.escape: Right after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is used, you have less need to wait cautiously for his stun. If he is holding a gold card, save Ziggs W Satchel Charge to escape.
TwistedFate.fight: Keep your distance and harass with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb while Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is ready. If he has used the gold card or Twisted Fate R Destiny is down, restrict his movement with Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield and look for a trade.
TwistedFate.laning: Push the wave with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb, and aim for the space Twisted Fate will move into when he stops to last-hit or cast a spell. Before pressuring the turret, check that Ziggs W Satchel Charge is back up and you have vision.
TwistedFate.phase: Ziggs is strongest in the late game once he has built up Ability Power, but he is fragile, so fight from farther back.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Start behind your allies, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield along Twisted Fate’s approach, and attack with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. Aim Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb at the center of a group. If you see Twisted Fate R Destiny’s teleport within range, interrupt it with Ziggs W Satchel Charge.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in a gold card with W Pick a Card, his next basic attack stuns, so stay outside his basic attack range. You can reduce the harass damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards by getting hit behind minions.

Twitch.build: Get a mana item first so you can pressure the lane with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. Building only one type of resistance will block only part of Twitch E Contaminate, and no resistance reduces the true damage from Twitch P Deadly Venom. Manage your distance to take fewer basic attacks rather than relying on one resistance, and consider ways to reduce his attack speed if needed.
Twitch.combo: When Twitch’s position is revealed, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield under him or along his retreat path, then throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb when he is slowed. If you can afford to use Ziggs W Satchel Charge offensively, place it behind Twitch, throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb, then knock him toward where it will land.
Twitch.escape: Decide whether to engage when Twitch Q Ambush’s camouflage ends and his position is revealed. Twitch has no ability to create distance on his own, so close the distance with Ziggs W Satchel Charge, then hit him with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb when he is slowed by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield. If Twitch W Venom Cask has landed under you, leave the cloud first.
Twitch.fight: Usually, harass with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from outside Twitch’s basic attack range, and block his retreat path with Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield when he steps forward. When Twitch Q Ambush’s camouflage ends, revealing his position, and you can safely close the distance, you can engage with Ziggs W Satchel Charge. While you lack vision, save Ziggs W Satchel Charge to escape.
Twitch.laning: Push the wave with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb to create a chance to pressure the turret, but first make sure Ziggs W Satchel Charge is ready and you have vision nearby. If Twitch disappears from lane, tell your allies he may be circling behind another lane. When you can hit the turret, use Ziggs P Short Fuse empowered basic attacks, and save Ziggs W Satchel Charge to finish off a weakened turret.
Twitch.phase: Early on, Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb has a slow harass cycle, so don’t pressure too aggressively. Ziggs deals heavy damage in the late game once he has built up Ability Power, but stay farther back to watch for Twitch’s camouflaged engage.
Twitch.teamfight: Start behind your allies, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield along Twitch’s approach, and save Ziggs W Satchel Charge to protect yourself. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, spread sideways from your allies so you aren’t all hit by his piercing basic attacks. Focus your team’s attacks on Twitch after his camouflage ends, and aim Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb at the center when enemies are grouped or trapped in a narrow area.
Twitch.watch: Twitch Q Ambush can take him around behind you when he disappears, so avoid brush where there is no vision and narrow paths, and alert your allies. Move out immediately if Twitch W Venom Cask lands under you. If you’ve been hit by several basic attacks, create distance even if you still have health, since you need to watch for Twitch E Contaminate. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, retreat to account for its increased range, and don’t line up with your allies.

Varus.build: Use Cloth Armor to hold on early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Varus’s main damage from Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows is physical, so build armor first.
Varus.combo: Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield under Varus or along his retreat path first, then throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb when he is slowed. Look for this sequence while dodging when you see Varus Q Piercing Arrow being aimed. If you can place Ziggs W Satchel Charge behind Varus, throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb, then knock him toward where it will land.
Varus.escape: When Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow, moving out of its path creates a chance to close the distance. Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so after dodging Varus R Chain of Corruption, engage with Ziggs W Satchel Charge if you have a safe angle. Don’t use it to engage if you may need Ziggs W Satchel Charge to escape.
Varus.fight: Usually, harass with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from outside Varus’s basic attack range. While Varus Q Piercing Arrow is being aimed, sidestep its path and block his retreat route with Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield. If you dodge Varus R Chain of Corruption and get a chance to close the distance, you can engage with Ziggs W Satchel Charge.
Varus.laning: Push the wave with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb to bring it under Varus’s turret and make time to hit the turret with basic attacks empowered by Ziggs P Short Fuse. Block Varus’s retreat path with Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield when he steps forward, but check your vision and make sure you can use Ziggs W Satchel Charge before pushing.
Varus.phase: Ziggs is strong in the late game once he has built up Ability Power, but he is fragile, so fight from farther back.
Varus.teamfight: Start behind your allies, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield along Varus’s approach, and harass with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. Spread out from your allies so Varus R Chain of Corruption doesn’t spread to several of you, and use Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb where enemies are grouped. If Varus gets a kill or assist, back off and wait out his empowered few seconds.
Varus.watch: If Varus W Blighted Quiver empowers a basic attack and applies Blight, his next abilities deal damage based on your maximum health. If you’ve been hit by several basic attacks, retreat and give the stacks time to expire. When you see Varus Q Piercing Arrow being aimed, sidestep its path. If an ally is caught by Varus R Chain of Corruption, stay away to avoid the chain root.

Xayah.build: Xayah’s main damage is physical, and Ziggs has low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to hold on early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Xayah.combo: Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield along Xayah’s retreat path or under her, then throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb when she is slowed. If Xayah R Featherstorm is down and you can use Ziggs W Satchel Charge offensively, place it behind Xayah, throw Q, then knock her toward where it will land.
Xayah.escape: Before closing the distance with Ziggs W Satchel Charge, watch the path of the feathers recalled by Xayah E Bladecaller and sidestep any line that would root you.
Xayah.fight: Don’t fight in the same spot against Xayah for long; harass briefly, then reposition. After Xayah R Featherstorm is down, you can close the distance with Ziggs W Satchel Charge, but save W if you need it to escape.
Xayah.laning: Harass with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from outside Xayah’s basic attack range, and block her retreat path with Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield when she steps forward. Push the wave with Q to pressure the turret, but check that Ziggs W Satchel Charge is ready and you have vision before pushing.
Xayah.phase: Ziggs is strong in the late game once he has built up Ability Power, but he is still fragile, so fight from farther back.
Xayah.teamfight: Start behind your allies, place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield along Xayah’s approach, and harass with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb. If Xayah R Featherstorm is still available, look for an opening after her ultimate is down instead of engaging first with Ziggs W Satchel Charge. When enemies are grouped or gathered in a narrow area, hit them with the center of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb.
Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots if she hits you with at least three returning feathers, so watch the line between Xayah and the feathers on the ground. If three or more feathers cross that line, move sideways instead of retreating straight back.

Zeri.build: Weather the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Also keep an eye on your total health, since Zeri P Living Battery deals damage based on maximum health and has an execute.
Zeri.combo: Place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield under Zeri or along her escape route, then hit her with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb when she is slowed. If Zeri E Spark Surge is down and it’s safe to use Ziggs W Satchel Charge, place the charge behind her and knock her toward where Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb will land.
Zeri.escape: Close the distance right after Zeri E Spark Surge is used. You can engage with Ziggs W Satchel Charge then, but don’t chase if Zeri R Lightning Crash is active.
Zeri.fight: Trade with Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb from outside Zeri’s short basic attack range. Right after you force Zeri to use E Spark Surge, you have a chance to close the distance, so use Ziggs W Satchel Charge then if you need it. Ziggs W Satchel Charge is your only mobility tool, so don’t use it to poke when you may need it to escape.
Zeri.laning: Then throw Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb where Zeri is about to last-hit or walk, and block her retreat with Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield if she steps forward. Before pushing the lane to pressure her turret, first check that Ziggs W Satchel Charge is ready and that you have vision.
Zeri.phase: Ziggs’s poke rotation is slow early, but Zeri doesn’t have much kill pressure, so build a lead before she gets her core items. Invest more in Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb and push the lane hard to pressure her turret from midgame, once you have mana items. Ziggs gets strong late as he builds ability power, but he is fragile and Zeri becomes harder to catch because of her mobility, so stay farther back.
Zeri.teamfight: Start behind your allies and place Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield in advance along Zeri’s approach. Keep throwing Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb during the fight, and use Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb when the enemy is grouped up or in terrain that makes escape difficult. If Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, don’t chase on foot; keep Ziggs W Satchel Charge available to protect yourself.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads widely when it hits terrain, so don’t stand with a wall behind you or face her head-on in narrow passages. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther when crossing walls, so don’t push her toward one. After Zeri R Lightning Crash is activated, her movement speed increases with each hit, so don’t chase her.

carryBasis: Exact source-card equality excluding population ranks, and byte-identical current runtime material across patches. Changed Summoner’s Rift item mentions excluded; the Shadowflame Korean rewording was reviewed as semantically unchanged. Historical answer quality is not newly approved.
